blind_spots.why_likely_missing: the pitch treats C2 integration as a plug-in capability ('feeds directly into') rather than a comms-constrained problem
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Streams live detection and engagement data / Feeds directly into existing C2 systems

blind_spots.blind_spot: IFF display (FRIENDLY / ENEMY DRONE / Neutralized / Unidentified) with no mention of ATAK/TAK integration
blind_spots.operator_reality: battlespace-awareness and target-ID tools are increasingly expected to plug into the TAK ecosystem rather than run a standalone C2 feed; a bespoke IFF/targeting display outside TAK risks becoming an isolated tool that doesn't generalize across units

blind_spots.evidence_quote: Nexus connects every deployment through a unified targeting software layer.

blind_spots.why_likely_missing: the company's entire go-to-market message is speed-of-fielding as a product feature, with no visible compliance roadmap alongside the USARPAC SBIR expansion
